begin_of_turn_query.content: 確保燃油箱充足，添加38公升的汽油，以便我們為即將到來的長途航行做好充分準備。加油時僅填充整數量；若不是整數則四捨五入。加油完成後，自信地啟動引擎，並確保所有門都已鎖好，停車煞車已啟動以作為安全措施。

Round to nearest integer: 10 gallons. So we call fillFuelTank with fuelAmount 10. Then startEngine with ignitionMode "START". Then lockDoors with unlock false, door list all? Also maybe display status? Not required. So sequence: convert liters to gallons, round, fillFuelTank, startEngine, lockDoors, activateParkingBrake. Let's do that.
